environment.description: Node.js 18 migration service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate validation). Service is accessible to any authenticated user within the VPC via service discovery. ALB forwards all POST requests to the target group without additional filtering.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, ACM certificate for server TLS only
config.network: Private subnet, accessible via VPC service discovery
config.auth: No additional authentication layer beyond network access
